title: From Fragmentation to Fusion: A Survey and Roadmap for Omnimodal Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2611.00172v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Embedding models underpin virtually every modern AI system, from search engines to recommendation systems. Despite shared mathematical foundations, research on embedding models remains fragmented by modality: the communities develop largely in isolation, seldom exchanging insights. We argue that this fragmentation obscures a deeper convergence. Driven by contrastive learning, Transformer architectures, and a granularity shift, embedding research across modalities is converging toward a common set of principles, even as modality-specific challenges remain underexplored. To reason across this convergence without conflating it, we propose a framework of three progressively harder capabilities: coverage, comparability, and compositionality. Three paths toward unification satisfy these in turn: transformation broadens coverage, alignment enables comparability, and joint embedding, the terminus we advocate, aims at compositionality. translated_title: 从碎片化到融合：全模态嵌入的综述与路线图
translated_abstract: 嵌入模型支撑着几乎所有现代AI系统，从搜索引擎到推荐系统。尽管共享相同的数学基础，但嵌入模型的研究仍因模态不同而碎片化：各个社区的发展在很大程度上相互隔离，很少交流见解。我们认为这种碎片化掩盖了一种更深层次的趋同。在对比学习、Transformer架构和粒度转变的驱动下，跨模态的嵌入研究正汇聚于一套共同的原则，尽管模态特定的挑战仍未得到充分探索。为了在不混淆这种趋同的前提下对其进行推理，我们提出了一个由三种递进式能力构成的框架：覆盖性、可比性和组合性。通向统一的三条路径依次满足这些能力：转换拓宽了覆盖性，对齐实现了可比性，而联合嵌入——我们倡导的终极目标——则旨在实现组合性。这一立场……
tldr: 该综述指出跨模态嵌入研究正因对比学习、Transformer架构和粒度转变而走向统一，提出了“覆盖性—可比性—组合性”三层递进能力框架，并倡导以联合嵌入作为实现全模态统一的最终路径。
en_tdlr: This survey argues that omnimodal embedding research is converging toward shared principles, proposes a three-tier capability framework of coverage, comparability, and compositionality, and advocates joint embedding as the ultimate path toward unification.
